services.desc: Tour Tickets ordered on line will be held at the Ross & Boone Gift Shoppe in your name. Tickets can be picked up at the time of your tour inside the Gift Shoppe. To facilitate ticket processing print out the Ticket form after purchase and bring it with you to the tour. The Jackson Mansion is open for tours from April to December on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Saturdays. There are two guided tours on each of these days at 10:30 a.m. and again at 1:00 p.m. Please visit us at the Ross & Boone Gift Shoppe, located behind the mansion, to meet your guide and arrange for your tour.
